note: tray student v2 (build8_tray_student.md sec. 1g): the per-step CNN of v1 (inputs ONLY top + wrist RGB at 288 px with the tray, q, qdot; ResNet18 to layer3 per camera, 32 spatial-softmax keypoints + 64-d pool, MLP 512-512 -> 10 x 6 joint targets as (target - q), masked L1), trained on the state of EVERY 20 ms step; executed with a query every step, ACT-style temporal ensembling of the overlapping chunks (coefficient 0.01: about uniform), and the jaw target taken 8 steps ahead in each chunk (the cube-blocked jaw hides the first steps of an opening)
